about: Berthoud's annual Parade of Lights opens the holiday season in downtown Berthoud, Colorado.
The 2026 parade is Saturday, December 5, and begins at 5 PM.
Floats line up on Second Street starting at 4 PM.
The route follows Mountain Avenue from Second Street to Eighth Street.
Illuminated floats, twinkling displays and festive music make up the parade.
Caroling and the tree lighting ceremony begin at 5:45 PM.
At 6 PM families can warm up at holiday specials in downtown shops and restaurants.
A Very Merry Berthoud fills the day before the parade.
Activities include craft and cookie making and letters to Santa mailboxes.
Blacksmithing demonstrations take place along Mountain Avenue and kids can take photos with Santa.
Shops offer gift wrapping and special deals during the day.
No admission price is listed, so the parade is treated as free.

about: Catch the Glow is Estes Park's lighted holiday parade.
The 2026 parade is Friday, November 27, from 5:30 to 6:30 PM.
Visit Estes Park lists the Estes Park Events Complex as the presenter.
The complex is at 1125 Rooftop Way in Estes Park.
The listing shows the event as free.
More than 40 entries take part.
Handcrafted floats come from the Town of Estes Park and local nonprofits.
Marching bands add music to the route.
Gleaming fire trucks and specialty vehicles roll through.
Visit Loveland reports the illuminated floats travel Elkhorn Avenue.
Estes Park sits in the mountains, so evenings are cold in late November.
